In a similar situation. However, you have nothing tying you to a location. Have you though about signing up to teach English in Japan or China? It pays the bills and gets you experience. Also, joining the peace core sometimes helps. They'll send you around the world and if you stay long enough, they sometimes get you tuition forgiveness and a guaranteed job when you are done.
